Business travel on weekends also earns comp-off, as set out in the Travel and Expenses Policy (HR-POL-03, Section 6).

Leave without pay of up to 30 calendar days may be granted for personal reasons once annual leave has been exhausted. It requires approval from both the Department Head and the HR Business Partner. Employees with 7 or more years of service may apply for an unpaid sabbatical of up to 6 months, approved by the Director of Human Resources.
Employees must declare any actual or potential conflict of interest (for example a family member working for a supplier, or a personal investment in a competitor) within 30 days of it arising, using the Conflict of Interest form in PeoplePort. This process applies to work-related grievances, and concerns about unethical or illegal conduct can also be raised via the Speak-Up hotline.
